description: Estimates a Bitcoin network fee as virtual size × fee rate (the dashboard's fee estimator). The size comes from a named wallet pattern (p2wpkh, p2tr, p2wsh-2of3 or p2sh-p2wsh-2of3, default p2wpkh) with inputs (default 1) and outputs (default 2), using BIP141 weights and stated assumptions, or from a custom vbytes figure. The rate is the caller's sat/vB, or the current recommended rate for a priority (fastest, halfHour, hour, economy; default halfHour) from mempool.space, Blockstream as fallback. The amount being sent does not set the fee and is not accepted. Returns sats, the cost in AUD, USD, EUR or GBP at the cached spot, and all four recommended priority rates when the network cache has them. Out-of-range inputs are refused (the dashboard page clamps them). An estimate: no rate guarantees when a transaction confirms, and the wallet sets the final fee.
name: estimate_transaction_fee
title: Estimate a Bitcoin transaction fee
